scope: Registry-level defaults and paper-intent gate; not yet a mandatory integration in every legacy strategy/book engine.

Paper intent authorization requires exact registry membership plus a paper-capable registered status.
A caller-created PAPER_ELIGIBLE spec or stale version is rejected when it is not the exact current registered spec.
Shadow signals remain quantity-free observations; human approval is still required for the transition into PAPER_ELIGIBLE.
